jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Machine Learning Recommendations
jobs.description:
Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What's the role?

We are looking for a Director of Engineering, Machine Learning to lead Etsy's Recommendations, the team responsible for the algorithms and systems that power personalized onsite-discovery across our marketplace. This is a pivotal technical leadership role at the intersection of ML research, systems engineering, and product impact.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end technical strategy for how Etsy connects buyers with the right listings across the App Homefeed, Web Home, Shop Home, Listing pages, Cart, and Checkout pages. You will lead a team of ML engineers, applied scientists, and system engineers organized across three areas: candidate retrieval, ranking, and recommendation systems. You will drive the evolution of our models from state-of-the-art multi-interest retrieval and multi-task deep ranking to next-generation LLM-powered foresight recommendations and generative discovery experiences. The biggest unsolved challenge in front of this team is not just relevance — it is inspiration: helping buyers discover new ideas and start new shopping missions.

This opportunity is a full-time position reporting to the VP of Engineering at Search, Recommendations, and Ads.

What's this team like at Etsy?

The Recommendations organization sits at the heart of Etsy's marketplace. We own over 60 recommendation modules across Etsy's surfaces, with our most impactful work powering the App Homefeed, Web Home, Shop Home, Listing pages, Cart, and Checkout pages.

Our ML stack spans the full recommendation pipeline. On retrieval, we build and evolve our multi-interest user-to-listing embedding model as well as a LLM-powered system that generates forward-looking shopping ideas based on buyer personas. On ranking, we operate a multi-task deep ranking model jointly optimizing for clicks, favorites, ads-to-cart, and purchases. Underpinning all of this is ReactorRecs, our in-house serving and orchestration platform that composes retrieval, ranking, filtering, and experimentation across 200+ recommendation modules.

We believe in research grounded in real user impact. We run rigorous offline and online experiments, use LLM-based and human-in-the-loop evaluation, and hold ourselves to both engagement and discovery metrics.

What does the day-to-day look like?

Define and drive the multi-year product and technical roadmap for Recommendations ML, with particular focus on personalization, foresight, diversity, and content freshness — the four problems where we have the most room to grow.
Lead and grow a team of ML engineers, applied scientists, and platform engineers across retrieval, ranking, and systems sub-teams, each with its own engineering manager.
Partner closely with product, UX, and cross-functional ML teams (Search, Ads, Buyer Understanding, Content Understanding) to align on a coherent, end-to-end buyer experience and shared infrastructure investments.
Drive the architectural evolution from our current two-stage retrieval-and-ranking pipeline toward more generative and LLM-integrated recommendation architectures.
Set the technical bar for model development, experimentation, evaluation, and productionization — including our offline VQA and LLM-as-judge evaluation frameworks.
Champion a high-velocity experimentation culture: our Multi-Variant Dataset (MVD) framework allows parallel A/B tests across retrieval and ranking components, and you should know how to squeeze value out of every experiment.
Mentor and develop engineering talent at all levels, including Staff and Senior Staff engineers and the engineering managers who report to you.
Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities That Will Help You Thrive

Proven ability to lead and develop multi-disciplinary teams of ML engineers, applied scientists, and platform engineers, including managing managers and senior managers.
10+ years of progressive experience in ML engineering, with demonstrated success shipping large-scale recommendation, retrieval, or ranking systems into production.
A track record of driving complex, cross-functional technical programs to completion — including navigating shared infrastructure decisions with partner teams in Search, Ads, or adjacent ML platforms.
Sharp instincts for balancing near-term product impact with mid-to-long-term research investment, and the ability to communicate that trade-off clearly to both engineering and product leadership.
Familiarity with large-scale ML infrastructure: distributed training (TensorFlow, PyTorch), feature stores, model serving, and online experimentation frameworks.

Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.

Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. Salary ranges for this role vary by zone and are listed below.

Location

We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.

Salary Range

Geo-1: 296,000.00 - 400,000.00 USD Annual
Geo-2: 266,000.00 - 360,000.00 USD Annual

What's Next

If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.

Our Promise

At Etsy, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace furthers relevance, resilience, and longevity. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Etsy is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion or creed, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship or immigration status, marital or familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status**, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law**. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during any part of the interview or hiring process, please let your recruiter know and we will work with you to meet your needs. While Etsy supports visa sponsorship, sponsorship opportunities may be limited to certain roles and skills.

jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Team

Job Description

Our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team consists of highly skilled engineers responsible for maintaining and enhancing the reliability, scalability, and performance of the ServiceNow infrastructure. Our SRE’s are empowered to resolve technical issues across the entire technology stack, from hardware to applications. Additionally, they work to improve the platform's operability, aiming to reduce the number of incidents and minimize Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR). To achieve this, the team combines software development, networking, database, and systems engineering skills to tackle complex problems, striving to maintain our platform operating for our customers.

Role

We are looking for a Director of Site Reliability Engineering to lead the next phase of our reliability transformation as ServiceNow modernizes toward a cloud-agnostic, cloud-ready production platform.

This leader will own key elements of the SRE operating model across Reliability Engineering, Service Enablement, Service Registry, SLI/SLO standards, reliability governance, automation, AI-enabled operations, and production readiness
. The role will lead a global engineering organization and partner across Product Engineering, Infrastructure, Architecture, Security, Release Engineering, and Customer Support to establish consistent reliability practices across ServiceNow products and services.

The Director will play a critical role in evolving the organization from reactive operations toward an engineering-led SRE model focused on prevention, automation, resilience, and continuous improvement
.

What You Get To Do In This Role

Define and execute the SRE strategy and operating model across reliability engineering, service enablement, observability, automation, incident learning, and production readiness.
Lead and develop a global organization of engineering managers, technical leaders, and SREs.
Establish enterprise reliability standards for service ownership, tiering, golden signals, SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, alerting, on-call practices, and service health reviews.
Lead the Service Enablement strategy by establishing minimum reliability requirements and maturity standards for critical services.
Own the Service Registry strategy, improving service ownership, dependency visibility, maturity tracking, and impact-aware operational decision-making.
Drive adoption of SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and burn-rate alerting across critical services, ensuring teams consistently use reliability signals to manage customer impact.
Build a culture of engineering away toil by turning recurring operational work and incident patterns into automation, self-service, and systemic fixes.
Establish the AI-enabled SRE roadmap, including change-risk assessment, operational insights, remediation recommendations, and policy-driven automation.
Drive reliability and production-readiness strategy across AWS, Azure, and GCP by establishing cloud-agnostic patterns while addressing hyperscaler-specific operational requirements.
Partner with product and platform engineers to design, launch, and operate reliable services throughout the production lifecycle.
Establish launch and production-readiness practices that validate availability, latency, performance, capacity, dependencies, rollback, and recovery before customer impact.
Drive sustainable operations by scaling self-service capabilities, automation platforms, and systemic reliability improvements across engineering teams.
Lead incident response, blameless postmortems, and corrective actions that convert production failures into lasting reliability improvements.
Measure reliability through SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, golden signals, change failure rate, MTTR, capacity health, and toil reduction.
Influence architecture and platform direction to simplify operating models and improve reliability across ServiceNow's global infrastructure.
Partner with executive and engineering leaders to prioritize reliability investments and drive adoption beyond the direct SRE organization.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
12 years of significant leadership experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering, Platform Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, or large-scale distributed systems with a Bachelor's degree; or 8 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 5 years experience; or equivalent experience.
Proven success leading managers and senior technical leaders across geographically distributed engineering organizations.
Demonstrated success leading SRE, infrastructure, or reliability transformation at scale.
Strong understanding of SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, observability, incident management, reliability governance, and on-call practices.
Experience with service catalogs, service registries, service ownership models, Backstage, CMDB, dependency mapping, or service topology.
Strong background in cloud infrastructure and modernization across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
Understanding of Kubernetes, distributed systems, networking, databases, infrastructure automation, and cloud-native architecture.
Experience driving automation through orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, self-service platforms, and auto-remediation.
Familiarity with AI-assisted operations, autonomous remediation, or agentic technologies is highly desirable.
Experience establishing production-readiness practices for releases, resilience, disaster recovery, infrastructure changes, and cloud migrations.
Ability to use incident, reliability, and operational data to prioritize engineering work and drive systemic improvements.
Strong cross-functional influence and executive communication skills.
Ability to operate effectively through ambiguity, organizational transformation, and large-scale technical change.

We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. POSITION SPECIFICS

Your working location will be fully on-site located in State College, PA. This role requires periodic travel to remote locations.

We are searching for a Department Head for the Agile Systems Engineering Department (ASE) of the Materials, Manufacturing and Sustainment Office (MMSO) at the Applied Research Laboratory (ARL) at Penn State. The Agile Systems Engineering Department is dedicated to the application and training of systems engineering to support the advancement of warfighter capability at the speed of relevance. The department focuses on the rapid development of complex engineering systems requiring the integration of cross-disciplinary solutions and expertise, including system architecture design, functional analysis, requirements development, and model-based engineering. Additionally, the department has a lead role in workforce development and systems engineering training. This role will lead and manage all aspects of the Agile Systems Engineering Department, providing strategic direction, technical leadership, and operational oversight of a department of approximately 10 people. This leadership position requires a visionary leader capable of building and directing a multidisciplinary team focused on tailored application of systems engineering, model-based engineering, architecture development, and rapid, tailored systems integration. This position may be filled as either a Research and Development Engineer or a non-tenure Research Faculty.

ARL is an authorized DoD SkillBridge partner and welcomes all transitioning military members to apply.

You will:

Lead and manage all aspects of the Agile Systems Engineering Department, providing strategic direction, technical leadership, and operational oversight, personnel management, workforce planning, talent development, and performance evaluation
Build and direct a multidisciplinary team focused on the application of systems engineering to a diverse set of programs, technologies and sponsors
Mentor systems engineers in applying systems engineering to a variety of complex engineering problems that span levels of technical maturity ranging from early science and technology to system acquisition
Support division leadership in developing and maintaining relationships with sponsors in support of meeting funding objectives
Lead individual research projects and portfolios including developing technical concepts, writing winning proposals, staffing projects, conducting research, managing budgets, and delivering high-quality results
Foster partnerships with U.S. Military Program Offices, defense contractors, systems integrators, and other government laboratories
Lead department personnel in developing and delivering training on systems engineering to ARL staff and external partners
Foster a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and mission focus

Build strategic relationships with Defense Industrial Base stakeholders
Collaborate across ARL departments and with external stakeholders as a trusted agent in identifying and applying appropriate systems engineering activities for large U.S. Military development programs

Leading individual research projects and portfolios including developing technical concepts, writing winning proposals, staffing the project, conducting the research, managing budgets, and delivering high-quality results

System and interface architecture development and testing

systems engineering challenges in complex systems (e.g., maritime, aerospace, ground vehicles, unmanned systems)

Description

The Director, Data Architecture & Engineering is responsible for advancing AGP's enterprise data architecture, engineering capabilities, platforms, and modernization initiatives. Reporting to the VP, Data Solutions & Campaign Deployment, this role provides technical leadership for the design and evolution of AGP's data ecosystem, ensuring data platforms, databases, pipelines, and integrations are scalable, secure, reliable, and positioned to support analytics, reporting, fundraising performance, and future business growth.

The Director serves as a senior technical leader and strategic partner across Strategic Intelligence, Campaign Operations, Analytics, Client Services and Technology. The role translates business requirements into scalable technical solutions, establishes data engineering and architecture standards, and identifies opportunities to modernize AGP's data environment while improving the performance and value of existing platforms.

A critical focus of this role is advancing AGP's use of AI within the data ecosystem. The Director will identify and lead opportunities to use AI, automation, and predictive technologies to improve data engineering, accelerate insights, increase efficiency, and create measurable value for AGP and its clients.

The ideal candidate is a pragmatic technical leader with a growth mindset who can balance modernization with the realities of an established data environment, maximizing the capabilities of existing systems while developing a thoughtful roadmap for future-state architecture and

Key Responsibilities

Lead the design, evolution, and optimization of AGP's enterprise data architecture, data platforms, warehouse environments, cloud infrastructure, and integration frameworks.
Develop and execute a data architecture and engineering roadmap that supports organizational growth, analytics, reporting, constituent intelligence, and emerging business requirements.
Establish and lead the vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI-driven tools within AGP's data ecosystem, enabling scalable automation, predictive intelligence, responsible AI adoption, and measurable business value.
Identify practical opportunities to embed AI and automation into data engineering, data quality, monitoring, analytics enablement, and other data workflows.
Design and optimize ETL/ELT frameworks, APIs, data pipelines, and integration patterns across fundraising, CRM, web analytics, financial, external data, and partner systems.
Establish technical standards and best practices for data engineering, architecture, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and performance optimization.
Establish and maintain technical standards for data quality, integrity, stewardship, access, retention, privacy, and lifecycle management in partnership with appropriate business and technology stakeholders.
Lead the technical design and optimization of operational and analytical database environments.
Design data models and analytical structures that support reporting, self-service analytics, predictive intelligence, machine learning, and fundraising optimization.
Advance AGP's modern data capabilities through technologies including Microsoft SQL Server, Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Python, APIs, and Snowflake where appropriate.
Implement automated monitoring, auditing, alerting, and remediation capabilities to improve the reliability and performance of AGP's data environment.
Evaluate existing data platforms, architecture, and technical debt and recommend modernization priorities based on business impact, scalability, cost, risk, and client value.
Partner with Analytics and Reporting teams to ensure data assets and architecture support accessible, reliable, and timely insights.
Partner with Campaign Operations to ensure architecture, platforms, and engineering solutions effectively support downstream campaign execution without assuming ownership of campaign deployment or operational delivery.
Partner with IT and Technology on data security, infrastructure, integrations, access controls, privacy, and applicable compliance requirements.
Serve as a senior technical resource for complex data architecture, engineering, integration, and platform challenges.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to data engineering and development resources while collaborating with the VP, Data Solutions & Campaign Deployment on resource priorities.
Evaluate emerging data and AI technologies and recommend adoption where they can materially improve efficiency, scalability, insight, or client value.

Qualifications

Education & Experience:
Bachelor's Degree (BA or BS) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
8–10+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, database administration, data architecture, or related technical disciplines, including experience leading complex technical initiatives, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred experience includes: Experience designing and modernizing enterprise data platforms and architecture.
Deep experience with Microsoft SQL Server, Azure, Microsoft Fabric, SQL, Python, ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, cloud-native data services, warehouse management, database optimization, and/or Snowflake.
Demonstrated experience working with large constituent, customer, donor, or transactional datasets.
Experience developing scalable data integrations and engineering frameworks across multiple systems and data sources.
Experience using AI, automation, predictive modeling, or machine learning to improve data processes and business outcomes.
Experience modernizing legacy data environments while maintaining critical operational systems.
Experience in direct marketing, fundraising, nonprofit, membership, agency, or other data-intensive environments.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Murmuration, we believe that America's promise is shaped and reshaped by the best ideas and ideals of its communities, and the dreams of the people who believe in a better life for themselves, their families, and each other.
We help organizations build power in their communities in four key ways: We organize a network of values-aligned partners; we provide deep, data-driven insights into people, places, and perspectives; we develop tools that make organizing and engagement easy and more effective; and we offer services that strengthen our partners' capacity to lead change in their communities.

We envision an America where every community has what it needs to help people lead healthy, free, and dignified lives. We work to redesign the systems and structures we all depend on — how we learn, live, govern, and solve problems — so that they are just, equitable, resilient, and rooted in shared responsibility. By strengthening the ties that hold communities together, we aim for civic life defined by collective action and care, with effective leadership that truly represents everyone.

We are a collaborative, curious, and creative team of organizers, scientists, teachers, technologists, campaign veterans, and more who share the unwavering belief that we can use our gifts in service of transforming America — together.
We've built our team guided by the belief that the whole is greater than the sum of its parts. And so we support each other relentlessly — rallying together to face challenges the same way we celebrate each other's wins.

About the Position

Do you see yourself as a mission-driven Senior Manager, Platform Engineering who believes that great products emerge from strong teams? Do you have a curiosity and passion for bringing related areas together and coaching people of different backgrounds and technical expertise into a cohesive, collaborative team? Do you thrive in inclusive, thoughtful environments where engineers hold themselves to high standards of technical excellence, ownership, and impact at scale?

The Murmuration Engineering Team is seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Platform Engineering to grow and develop the multidisciplinary team (DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps) that builds and maintains the shared systems that all of our teams depend on. Your guidance and influence on this team will raise the bar across the engineering organization.
Murmuration builds technology that helps our partner organizations strengthen civic engagement and organize more effectively in their communities. Our products weave together engagement, outreach, demographic, and voter data into intuitive applications that help partners better understand and act within the communities they serve. Our team is intentionally multidisciplinary and partner-focused. We succeed together by aligning planning, execution, and learning across engineering, product, design, research, data, and partner success. We build complex, data-driven systems that need to work reliably during critical moments, scale as our partners grow, and remain understandable and maintainable as communities and their needs evolve.

As a Senior Manager, Platform Engineering, you'll join the Platform Team to support both production and prototype applications and the services they're built upon. You'll coach and grow a small, cross-discipline team that owns the outcomes for the org's build/deploy/run systems, with accountability for other teams' ability to ship fast, safely, and reliably. The team’s disciplines span DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps domains.
Your leadership actively shapes the team's operating model, evolving it to serve the Engineering organization's current and future needs. Your strategic thinking turns vision into sequenced deliverables and adapts as priorities shift without losing sight of where the team is headed. Your commitment to high-quality documentation improves knowledge sharing, onboarding, and long-term product maintainability across Murmuration.

Your ability to work across engineering teams, understanding their goals and shaping the org's engineering roadmap around them, is key to making the Platform Team successful.
This role suits a deeply experienced Senior Manager, Platform Engineering who can evaluate where we are today, absorb shifts in direction, and keep us on track. Your commitment to building inclusive, high-trust, high-performing teams is visible across the technology organization. And you believe, as we do, that how we build is just as important as what we build.

Job Level: M4

Drive & Model

Shape technical strategy for the team: Build an engineering roadmap that keeps the team focused on big-picture objectives and that reflects tradeoffs among competing priorities, dependencies, and complexities across DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps. Propose clear recommendations and plans, and present well-reasoned documentation of tradeoffs and alternatives.
Manage technical debt and process health: Maintain a steady cadence of debt paydown, prioritizing which debt to tackle and communicating the reasoning behind those choices. Own the schedule of dependency and application updates so end-of-life deadlines are handled proactively rather than as last-minute fire drills.
Deliver production-ready platforms: Own the platforms and tooling that give other teams a stable, observable foundation of reliability, performance, and operational excellence so they can focus on building and testing their own applications on top of it.
Strengthen application security: Introspect codebases to identify vulnerabilities early, and own data privacy and access control as first-class concerns; deliver solutions that support secure coding practices across the org without owning how other teams write their code.
Enable FinOps visibility: Build and own the single panes of glass that give engineering leadership and the C-suite a clear, trusted view of cloud and infrastructure costs, supporting both short-term budget decisions and long-term cost strategy.
Architect for the long term: Design and build systems and architectures that will serve Murmuration for years with scale, reliability, security, and maintainability as first-class concerns.

Elevate the Team

Coach and empower emerging leaders: Coach leaders to lead at every level: Within their own teams, as good, collaborative, and experienced peers, and through mentoring ICs around them.
Resolve ambiguity: Actively shape and bring structure and clarity (not perfection) to specs.
Listen and elevate: Stay closely attuned to how other teams approach test strategy, code quality, and system design, and use that insight to ensure that what our team builds and delivers elevates their developer journey.
Be like Ted Lasso: Believe, coach the whole team, build trust, and demonstrate kindness, empathy, optimism, curiosity, and vulnerability.

Lead Beyond Platform

Lead beyond the Platform team: Own objectives that span multiple teams and align with division and organizational goals.
Be the voice: Lead with ownership and accountability on behalf of DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps; seek opportunities to add clarity, make high-quality recommendations, and be a decision-maker in discussions with product and leadership.
Identify risk: Identify, document, and follow-up in a timely manner on vulnerabilities and operational risk across the full platform, including applications built by other teams.
Lead incident response: Involve the right people across DevOps, App Security, SRE and FinOps, lead the response, conduct root cause analysis, and follow through until learnings are shared, incorporated, and remediation is complete.

Build with Vision

Build one internal engineering system, not four Platform teams: Treat DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps as interdependent subsystems where the outcome depends on how well they integrate, not how well each performs alone.
Present a cohesive voice and narrative externally: Lead with expertise and a cohesive single voice about the Platform Team’s mission and deliverables to our peer teams.
Be curious about people, not just systems: Identify opportunities to foster curiosity and ease communication between people who come from different backgrounds, experiences, and technical lenses.
Use AI to amplify: Surface risks and gaps that manual review would miss, and measure team progress together towards shared goals.

Requirements

Technical Depth and Judgement

Deep, hands-on expertise across DevOps and SRE: Your direct prior experience informs your approach to prioritizing competing work, communicating tradeoffs clearly, and explaining how a decision in DevOps, SRE, AppSec, or FinOps supports the organization as a whole.
Sound judgment under imperfect information: Make tradeoff calls to generate clarity in ambiguous situations.
Communicates effectively: Explain to non-technical leadership why an architecture decision is sound without needing the original author in the room.
Champions team decisions: Advocate for the team's technical decisions to peers, product, and leadership.

Scope, Initiative, and Execution

Lead execution at scale: Lead technical execution for initiatives spanning multiple teams or systems, balancing quality, performance, and cost while keeping stakeholders aligned on tradeoffs and risks.
Turn strategy into shipped deliverables: Translate objectives aligned with division and organizational goals into clear epics, stories, and tickets, anticipating technical challenges and proposing solutions before they become blockers.
Plan through ambiguity: Estimate large, cross-team projects with unknowns, building mitigation plans for what’s unresolved, and breaking work into milestones and iterations to reduce risk and deliver incremental value.
Drive to completion: Involve decision makers, delegate clearly, communicate consistently, and follow through as an owner, in a timely manner, until an outcome is delivered.
Multiply team effectiveness: Use technical leadership, tooling, infrastructure, and process improvements to multiply the impact of both the Platform Team and the Engineering organization.

Organizational Impact

Influence beyond the team: Shape outcomes beyond your own team through role modeling, documentation, and advocacy.
Mentor future leaders: Develop future technical leaders, building their judgment, ownership, and skills through 1:1 guidance and small-group knowledge sharing.
Raise the engineering bar: Drive the standards and best practices that raise the bar across the organization, creating processes that instill ownership behavior in others.
Lead by example: Proactively share context and learnings with an eye to creating the kind of high-trust, high-performing team culture that makes everyone better.

What You Bring to the Table

Foundations

10+ years of professional software manager engineering experience with demonstrated fluency across infrastructure, systems, and application layers, and a track record of delivering in production across a variety of languages, tools, and technology stacks.
A quality-driven mindset with experience writing, maintaining, and driving infrastructure and deployment safety checks at the team or product level.
A track record of effective collaboration with product, data science, and R&D teams, bridging technical and domain-specific perspectives across disciplines.

DevOps

Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and release engineering practices.
Production experience with AWS, including compute, storage, and networking services.
Proficiency with Docker, Make, or similar build tools, as well as environment scripting.
Fluency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or equivalent) across AWS, GCP, and Azure providers sufficient to evaluate design decisions, not just approve them.

App Security

Experience driving secure coding practices, data privacy principles, and access control patterns as applied in production systems.
Familiarity with security practice

Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What's the role?

We are looking for a Director of Engineering, Machine Learning to lead Etsy's Recommendations, the team responsible for the algorithms and systems that power personalized onsite-discovery across our marketplace. This is a pivotal technical leadership role at the intersection of ML research, systems engineering, and product impact.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end technical strategy for how Etsy connects buyers with the right listings across the App Homefeed, Web Home, Shop Home, Listing pages, Cart, and Checkout pages. You will lead a team of ML engineers, applied scientists, and system engineers organized across three areas: candidate retrieval, ranking, and recommendation systems. You will drive the evolution of our models from state-of-the-art multi-interest retrieval and multi-task deep ranking to next-generation LLM-powered foresight recommendations and generative discovery experiences. The biggest unsolved challenge in front of this team is not just relevance — it is inspiration: helping buyers discover new ideas and start new shopping missions.

This opportunity is a full-time position reporting to the VP of Engineering at Search, Recommendations, and Ads.

What's this team like at Etsy?

The Recommendations organization sits at the heart of Etsy's marketplace. We own over 60 recommendation modules across Etsy's surfaces, with our most impactful work powering the App Homefeed, Web Home, Shop Home, Listing pages, Cart, and Checkout pages.

Our ML stack spans the full recommendation pipeline. On retrieval, we build and evolve our multi-interest user-to-listing embedding model as well as a LLM-powered system that generates forward-looking shopping ideas based on buyer personas. On ranking, we operate a multi-task deep ranking model jointly optimizing for clicks, favorites, ads-to-cart, and purchases. Underpinning all of this is ReactorRecs, our in-house serving and orchestration platform that composes retrieval, ranking, filtering, and experimentation across 200+ recommendation modules.

We believe in research grounded in real user impact. We run rigorous offline and online experiments, use LLM-based and human-in-the-loop evaluation, and hold ourselves to both engagement and discovery metrics.

What does the day-to-day look like?

Define and drive the multi-year product and technical roadmap for Recommendations ML, with particular focus on personalization, foresight, diversity, and content freshness — the four problems where we have the most room to grow.
Lead and grow a team of ML engineers, applied scientists, and platform engineers across retrieval, ranking, and systems sub-teams, each with its own engineering manager.
Partner closely with product, UX, and cross-functional ML teams (Search, Ads, Buyer Understanding, Content Understanding) to align on a coherent, end-to-end buyer experience and shared infrastructure investments.
Drive the architectural evolution from our current two-stage retrieval-and-ranking pipeline toward more generative and LLM-integrated recommendation architectures.
Set the technical bar for model development, experimentation, evaluation, and productionization — including our offline VQA and LLM-as-judge evaluation frameworks.
Champion a high-velocity experimentation culture: our Multi-Variant Dataset (MVD) framework allows parallel A/B tests across retrieval and ranking components, and you should know how to squeeze value out of every experiment.
Mentor and develop engineering talent at all levels, including Staff and Senior Staff engineers and the engineering managers who report to you.
Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Proven ability to lead and develop multi-disciplinary teams of ML engineers, applied scientists, and platform engineers, including managing managers and senior managers.
10+ years of progressive experience in ML engineering, with demonstrated success shipping large-scale recommendation, retrieval, or ranking systems into production.
A track record of driving complex, cross-functional technical programs to completion — including navigating shared infrastructure decisions with partner teams in Search, Ads, or adjacent ML platforms.
Sharp instincts for balancing near-term product impact with mid-to-long-term research investment, and the ability to communicate that trade-off clearly to both engineering and product leadership.
Familiarity with large-scale ML infrastructure: distributed training (TensorFlow, PyTorch), feature stores, model serving, and online experimentation frameworks.

We help organizations build power in their communities in four key ways: We organize a network of values-aligned partners; we provide deep, data-driven insights into people, places, and perspectives; we develop tools that make organizing and engagement easy and more effective; and we offer services that strengthen our partners' capacity to lead change in their communities.

We envision an America where every community has what it needs to help people lead healthy, free, and dignified lives. We work to redesign the systems and structures we all depend on — how we learn, live, govern, and solve problems — so that they are just, equitable, resilient, and rooted in shared responsibility. By strengthening the ties that hold communities together, we aim for civic life defined by collective action and care, with effective leadership that truly represents everyone.

We are a collaborative, curious, and creative team of organizers, scientists, teachers, technologists, campaign veterans, and more who share the unwavering belief that we can use our gifts in service of transforming America — together.
We've built our team guided by the belief that the whole is greater than the sum of its parts. And so we support each other relentlessly — rallying together to face challenges the same way we celebrate each other's wins.

About the Position

Do you see yourself as a mission-driven Senior Manager, Platform Engineering who believes that great products emerge from strong teams? Do you have a curiosity and passion for bringing related areas together and coaching people of different backgrounds and technical expertise into a cohesive, collaborative team? Do you thrive in inclusive, thoughtful environments where engineers hold themselves to high standards of technical excellence, ownership, and impact at scale?

The Murmuration Engineering Team is seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Platform Engineering to grow and develop the multidisciplinary team (DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps) that builds and maintains the shared systems that all of our teams depend on. Your guidance and influence on this team will raise the bar across the engineering organization.
Murmuration builds technology that helps our partner organizations strengthen civic engagement and organize more effectively in their communities. Our products weave together engagement, outreach, demographic, and voter data into intuitive applications that help partners better understand and act within the communities they serve. Our team is intentionally multidisciplinary and partner-focused. We succeed together by aligning planning, execution, and learning across engineering, product, design, research, data, and partner success. We build complex, data-driven systems that need to work reliably during critical moments, scale as our partners grow, and remain understandable and maintainable as communities and their needs evolve.

As a Senior Manager, Platform Engineering, you'll join the Platform Team to support both production and prototype applications and the services they're built upon. You'll coach and grow a small, cross-discipline team that owns the outcomes for the org's build/deploy/run systems, with accountability for other teams' ability to ship fast, safely, and reliably. The team’s disciplines span DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps domains.
Your leadership actively shapes the team's operating model, evolving it to serve the Engineering organization's current and future needs. Your strategic thinking turns vision into sequenced deliverables and adapts as priorities shift without losing sight of where the team is headed. Your commitment to high-quality documentation improves knowledge sharing, onboarding, and long-term product maintainability across Murmuration.

Your ability to work across engineering teams, understanding their goals and shaping the org's engineering roadmap around them, is key to making the Platform Team successful.
This role suits a deeply experienced Senior Manager, Platform Engineering who can evaluate where we are today, absorb shifts in direction, and keep us on track. Your commitment to building inclusive, high-trust, high-performing teams is visible across the technology organization. And you believe, as we do, that how we build is just as important as what we build.

Job Level: M4

Drive & Model

Shape technical strategy for the team: Build an engineering roadmap that keeps the team focused on big-picture objectives and that reflects tradeoffs among competing priorities, dependencies, and complexities across DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps. Propose clear recommendations and plans, and present well-reasoned documentation of tradeoffs and alternatives.
Manage technical debt and process health: Maintain a steady cadence of debt paydown, prioritizing which debt to tackle and communicating the reasoning behind those choices. Own the schedule of dependency and application updates so end-of-life deadlines are handled proactively rather than as last-minute fire drills.
Deliver production-ready platforms: Own the platforms and tooling that give other teams a stable, observable foundation of reliability, performance, and operational excellence so they can focus on building and testing their own applications on top of it.
Strengthen application security: Introspect codebases to identify vulnerabilities early, and own data privacy and access control as first-class concerns; deliver solutions that support secure coding practices across the org without owning how other teams write their code.
Enable FinOps visibility: Build and own the single panes of glass that give engineering leadership and the C-suite a clear, trusted view of cloud and infrastructure costs, supporting both short-term budget decisions and long-term cost strategy.
Architect for the long term: Design and build systems and architectures that will serve Murmuration for years with scale, reliability, security, and maintainability as first-class concerns.

Elevate the Team

Coach and empower emerging leaders: Coach leaders to lead at every level: Within their own teams, as good, collaborative, and experienced peers, and through mentoring ICs around them.
Resolve ambiguity: Actively shape and bring structure and clarity (not perfection) to specs.
Listen and elevate: Stay closely attuned to how other teams approach test strategy, code quality, and system design, and use that insight to ensure that what our team builds and delivers elevates their developer journey.
Be like Ted Lasso: Believe, coach the whole team, build trust, and demonstrate kindness, empathy, optimism, curiosity, and vulnerability.

Lead Beyond Platform

Lead beyond the Platform team: Own objectives that span multiple teams and align with division and organizational goals.
Be the voice: Lead with ownership and accountability on behalf of DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps; seek opportunities to add clarity, make high-quality recommendations, and be a decision-maker in discussions with product and leadership.
Identify risk: Identify, document, and follow-up in a timely manner on vulnerabilities and operational risk across the full platform, including applications built by other teams.
Lead incident response: Involve the right people across DevOps, App Security, SRE and FinOps, lead the response, conduct root cause analysis, and follow through until learnings are shared, incorporated, and remediation is complete.

Build with Vision

Build one internal engineering system, not four Platform teams: Treat DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps as interdependent subsystems where the outcome depends on how well they integrate, not how well each performs alone.
Present a cohesive voice and narrative externally: Lead with expertise and a cohesive single voice about the Platform Team’s mission and deliverables to our peer teams.
Be curious about people, not just systems: Identify opportunities to foster curiosity and ease communication between people who come from different backgrounds, experiences, and technical lenses.
Use AI to amplify: Surface risks and gaps that manual review would miss, and measure team progress together towards shared goals.

Requirements

Technical Depth and Judgement

Deep, hands-on expertise across DevOps and SRE: Your direct prior experience informs your approach to prioritizing competing work, communicating tradeoffs clearly, and explaining how a decision in DevOps, SRE, AppSec, or FinOps supports the organization as a whole.
Sound judgment under imperfect information: Make tradeoff calls to generate clarity in ambiguous situations.
Communicates effectively: Explain to non-technical leadership why an architecture decision is sound without needing the original author in the room.
Champions team decisions: Advocate for the team's technical decisions to peers, product, and leadership.

Scope, Initiative, and Execution

Lead execution at scale: Lead technical execution for initiatives spanning multiple teams or systems, balancing quality, performance, and cost while keeping stakeholders aligned on tradeoffs and risks.
Turn strategy into shipped deliverables: Translate objectives aligned with division and organizational goals into clear epics, stories, and tickets, anticipating technical challenges and proposing solutions before they become blockers.
Plan through ambiguity: Estimate large, cross-team projects with unknowns, building mitigation plans for what’s unresolved, and breaking work into milestones and iterations to reduce risk and deliver incremental value.
Drive to completion: Involve decision makers, delegate clearly, communicate consistently, and follow through as an owner, in a timely manner, until an outcome is delivered.
Multiply team effectiveness: Use technical leadership, tooling, infrastructure, and process improvements to multiply the impact of both the Platform Team and the Engineering organization.

Organizational Impact

Influence beyond the team: Shape outcomes beyond your own team through role modeling, documentation, and advocacy.
Mentor future leaders: Develop future technical leaders, building their judgment, ownership, and skills through 1:1 guidance and small-group knowledge sharing.
Raise the engineering bar: Drive the standards and best practices that raise the bar across the organization, creating processes that instill ownership behavior in others.
Lead by example: Proactively share context and learnings with an eye to creating the kind of high-trust, high-performing team culture that makes everyone better.

What You Bring to the Table

Foundations

10+ years of professional software manager engineering experience with demonstrated fluency across infrastructure, systems, and application layers, and a track record of delivering in production across a variety of languages, tools, and technology stacks.
A quality-driven mindset with experience writing, maintaining, and driving infrastructure and deployment safety checks at the team or product level.
A track record of effective collaboration with product, data science, and R&D teams, bridging technical and domain-specific perspectives across disciplines.

DevOps

Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and release engineering practices.
Production experience with AWS, including compute, storage, and networking services.
Proficiency with Docker, Make, or similar build tools, as well as environment scripting.
Fluency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or equivalent) across AWS, GCP, and Azure providers sufficient to evaluate design decisions, not just approve them.

App Security

Experience driving secure coding practices, data privacy principles, and access control patterns as applied in production systems.
Familiarity with security practice
